description: This file defines the ProtocolServices class which implements ILogConsistencyProtocolServices. It provides distributed protocol utility functions, including logging, error handling, exception catching, and deep copying, within the Orleans distributed runtime, focusing on log consistency. It is used by log view adaptors to expose runtime-internal services to provider code that cannot access internals directly.

classes.name: ProtocolServices
classes.description: A class providing log consistency protocol services for use in distributed log view adaptors within Orleans, including logging, error reporting, exception handling, and deep copying. Stores grain-specific information and interacts with internal Orleans runtime components.

methods.name: ProtocolServices
methods.description: Constructor for ProtocolServices, initializes grain context, logger, deep copier, and cluster ID based on silo details.

methods.name: GrainId
methods.description: Property that retrieves the GrainId from the grain context.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of a given value using the DeepCopier.

methods.name: ProtocolError
methods.description: Logs a protocol error message; throws OrleansException if specified.

methods.name: CaughtException
methods.description: Logs an exception caught at a specific point.

methods.name: CaughtUserCodeException
methods.description: Logs an exception thrown within user code, indicating the callback and location.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified log level and format, including grain ID prefix.
